pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which two days make up the weekend (das Wochenende)? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag and Sonntag
   B. Montag and Dienstag
   C. Sonntag and Montag
   D. Freitag and Samstag

2. What does "die Kerze" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. candle
   B. balloon
   C. song
   D. cake

3. What does "der Geburtstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. balloon
   B. birthday
   C. candle
   D. party

4. What does "nett" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. old
   B. kind
   C. tall or big
   D. small

5. What does "Sie ist alt, aber sehr nett" mean? (1 mark)
   A. She is old but very kind
   B. She is tall and strong
   C. She is old and unkind
   D. She is young and funny

6. What does "das Bett" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bathroom
   B. bed
   C. door
   D. sofa

7. Which day comes right before Donnerstag? (1 mark)
   A. Freitag
   B. Dienstag
   C. Sonntag
   D. Mittwoch

8. Which sentence has the verb in second place? (1 mark)
   A. Ich am Montag gehe zur Schule.
   B. Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule.
   C. Zur Schule am Montag ich gehe.
   D. Am Montag ich gehe zur Schule.

9. What does "der Samstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. weekend
   B. Tuesday
   C. Saturday
   D. Thursday

10. Which German word is the number 4? (1 mark)
   A. sechs
   B. eins
   C. zehn
   D. vier

11. What does "Juli" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. January
   B. July
   C. November
   D. September

12. What does "Kamau hat Geburtstag" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kamau has a birthday
   B. Kamau has a cake
   C. Kamau is tired
   D. Kamau is ten

13. What is the plural of "die Bohne"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bohne
   B. die Bohner
   C. die Bohnes
   D. die Bohnen

14. Which food group does "die Tomate" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Obst
   D. das Gemüse

15. What does "die Wolke" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. thunderstorm
   B. wind
   C. weather
   D. cloud

16. What does "fleißig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hard-working
   B. tall or big
   C. kind
   D. young

17. Which sentence is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Mein Vater bist groß.
   B. Mein Vater bin groß.
   C. Mein Vater sind groß.
   D. Mein Vater ist groß.

18. What does "klein" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. funny
   B. strong
   C. hard-working
   D. small

19. Which German word or phrase means "living room"? (1 mark)
   A. das Wohnzimmer
   B. der Stuhl
   C. der Topf
   D. die Uhr

20. Which sentence is written correctly? (1 mark)
   A. Der Tisch ist in dem Küche.
   B. Der Tisch ist in der Küche.
   C. Der Tisch ist im Küche.
   D. Der Tisch ist in der Kuche.

21. Which German word or phrase means "radio"? (1 mark)
   A. der Stuhl
   B. der Schrank
   C. der Teller
   D. das Radio

22. What does "April" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. November
   B. April
   C. September
   D. July

23. What does "der erste" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. third
   B. seventh
   C. sixth
   D. first

24. What does "August" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. June
   B. September
   C. August
   D. July

25. Which little word goes with the noun "Kohl"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. das
   D. den

26. Which mark comes after a meal name in a menu, as in "Frühstück: Tee und Brot"? (1 mark)
   A. a colon
   B. a question mark
   C. a full stop
   D. a hyphen

27. Which little word goes with the noun "Mais"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. das
   D. die

28. Which little word goes with the noun "Fuß"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. das
   D. der

29. Which word completes "Ich habe ___ Kopf"? (1 mark)
   A. einen
   B. ein
   C. einer
   D. eine

30. Which German word or phrase means "mouth"? (1 mark)
   A. der Zeh
   B. das Haar
   C. der Mund
   D. der Bauch

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the forms of "sein" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)

32. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shower, bean. (2 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: face, father. (2 marks)

34. Write the German words with der, die or das for: clock, leg, house, spoon. (4 marks)

35. Write the German words with der, die or das for: supper, shower, bean, fork. (4 marks)

36. Describe the structure of an Elfchen, line by line. (3 marks)

37. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sofa, bathroom, potato, milk, finger. (5 marks)

38. Write three sentences about what you do on three different days. Start each with "Am". (3 marks)

39. Write the German names of these months: April, May, June. (3 marks)

40. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back, sugar, child. (5 marks)

41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: water, rice, breakfast. (3 marks)

42. Unscramble and write with the article: FELPA and SERI. (4 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear. (3 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lamp, tomato. (2 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: daughter, orange. (2 marks)

46. Unscramble the letters KLAT and NEGER. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Samstag and Sonntag
   The weekend is Saturday and Sunday.

2. A — candle
   die Kerze means candle.

3. B — birthday
   der Geburtstag means birthday.

4. B — kind
   nett means kind.

5. A — She is old but very kind
   alt = old, aber = but, sehr nett = very kind.

6. B — bed
   das Bett means bed.

7. D — Mittwoch
   Before Donnerstag comes Mittwoch.

8. B — Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule.
   In German the verb is the second idea in a statement.

9. C — Saturday
   der Samstag means Saturday.

10. D — vier
   4 in German is vier.

11. B — July
   Juli means July.

12. A — Kamau has a birthday
   hat Geburtstag means has a birthday.

13. D — die Bohnen
   The plural of die Bohne is die Bohnen.

14. D — das Gemüse
   die Tomate belongs to das Gemüse.

15. D — cloud
   die Wolke means cloud.

16. A — hard-working
   fleißig means hard-working.

17. D — Mein Vater ist groß.
   Vater is he, so we use ist.

18. D — small
   klein means small.

19. A — das Wohnzimmer
   living room in German is das Wohnzimmer.

20. B — Der Tisch ist in der Küche.
   Küche is a die word: in der Küche, with a capital K.

21. D — das Radio
   radio in German is das Radio.

22. B — April
   April means April.

23. D — first
   der erste means first.

24. C — August
   August means August.

25. B — der
   It is der Kohl, so the little word is der.

26. A — a colon
   The colon announces what follows.

27. A — der
   It is der Mais, so the little word is der.

28. D — der
   It is der Fuß, so the little word is der.

29. A — einen
   Kopf is a der word, so we say einen.

30. C — der Mund
   mouth in German is der Mund.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich bin, du bist, er ist.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Dusche, die Bohne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gesicht, der Vater.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Uhr, das Bein, das Haus, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Abendessen, die Dusche, die Bohne, die Gabel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Line 1: one word; line 2: two words; line 3: three words; line 4: four words; line 5: one word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for lines 1 and 2, 1 mark for lines 3 and 4, 1 mark for line 5 and the total of 11.

37. (5 marks)
   Answer: das Sofa, das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch, der Finger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule. Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball. Am Sonntag gehe ich in die Kirche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with a capital letter, verb in second place and a full stop.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: April, Mai, Juni.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken, der Zucker, das Kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Wasser, der Reis, das Frühstück.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Apfel and der Reis.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Lampe, die Tomate.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Tochter, die Orange.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: kalt and Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each; nouns with a capital letter, adjectives with a small letter.
